name: agent-trust-sdk
description: AgenticTrust workspace: @agentic-trust/sdk, @agentic-trust/cli, and @agentic-trust/mcp-server. Hosted registry: Trustflow Systems.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/sdk build && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/cli build && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/mcp-server build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/sdk build && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/mcp-server typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/sdk test && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/cli test && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/mcp-server test
scripts.smoke: pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/sdk build && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/cli build && pnpm --filter @agentic-trust/cli smoke
